seo_need.cost_of_absence: Concrete: Axiamatic isn't on the vendor-written 'best AI tools for SAP S/4HANA transformation' list (Oct 2026). That list puts smaller, less-funded rivals (Qorelo $3.5M, Tessera Labs) in front of the same buyers, and it is the kind of page AI answers draw on. Axiamatic ranks only for its own name and the SAP Store, with no category pages, comparisons or guides. Its llms.txt still feeds AI crawlers the old 'Copilots for ERP modernization' line. While the category is being named, others are naming it. Mitigant: deals are SI/AE-led, so the cost shows up in the shortlist and in category perception, not in inbound volume.
seo_need.why_not_yet: founder_led: all content is written by the CEO, there's no marketing hire (the PMM role has been open since 2026-03-10), and the GTM build has been sales-first (Head of Sales June 2026, AEs, channels). The company is 8 months out of stealth, not a mature company that chose not to invest.
